name: Javi López, Borja Giménez Larraz - § 36 - Am 23
title: INTERIM REPORT in view of the consent procedure on the Political, Economic and Cooperation Strategic Partnership Agreement between the EU and Mexico
part_text: 36. Stresses that all imports from Mexico must fully comply with EU requirements with regard to food safety, animal and plant health, consumer safety, environmental protection, technical product standards, and regulations on genetically modified organisms; expresses concern about the use of active substances not approved in the EU, such as atrazine, and evidence of higher pesticide residues in Mexican products; welcomes the recent decision by President Claudia Sheinbaum to ban 35 highly hazardous pesticides; calls on the Commission to ensure strengthened controls and full compliance with EU standards;
